tenderSchedule.description: Hiring of agency for supplying WSO, WAV,AWSO Manpower Services to TMC VIjayapura

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contract period will be for 36 months subjected to review of performance of the Contractor. Contract is liable for termination at anytime prior notice of 30 days from Chief Officer, TMC Vijayapura
Tenderer Should quote their service charge in Rupees only
Wrongly quoting of Financial Bid shall be liable for rejection.
Tender called for only service charges only. Minimum wages and ESI, PF will be paid on monthly bill additionally as per prevailing Govt orders.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least three financial years in last five years annual financial turnover of more than Rs. 80.00 lakhs
Filed copies of Income tax returns for last three financial years
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. 15.00 Lakhs
Satisfactory completed, at least 3 years Out of 3 years at least one year of experience in manpower supply of 15 Nos OR more for any Urban Local Body
Service provider needs to submit the firm registration certificates& Karnataka labour department Registration Certificate
